findings: Feature resolution and crate wiring: In public-code/aws-lc-rs-1.18.1/Cargo.toml, aws-lc-sys 0.45.0 is declared with optional = true and default-features = false. With the observed tree features aws-lc-rs 1.18.1 = [aws-lc-sys, prebuilt-nasm] and aws-lc-sys 0.45.0 = [prebuilt-nasm], aws-lc-sys's default feature (all-bindings) as well as bindgen, fips, asan, disable-prebuilt-nasm, and ssl are all disabled. In aws-lc-sys 0.45.0/Cargo.toml, the optional build-dependency bindgen 0.72.0 (gated on bindgen or fips) is not activated; unconditionally active build-dependencies on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu are cc (with feature parallel), cmake, dunce, fs_extra, and cfg(unix) pkg-config.

aws-lc-rs 1.18.1/build.rs branch and env trace: Neither fips nor non-fips is enabled, so the mutual-exclusion assert passes. It emits rustc-check-cfg for aws_lc_rs_docsrs, disable_slow_tests, and dev_tests_only, reads AWS_LC_RS_DISABLE_SLOW_TESTS and AWS_LC_RS_DEV_TESTS_ONLY (emitting cargo:rerun-if-env-changed for both; PROFILE is only read if dev-tests-only feature or AWS_LC_RS_DEV_TESTS_ONLY=1 is active), selects sys_crate = "aws-lc-sys" via cfg!(feature = "aws-lc-sys"), skips the Windows MSVC crt-static link-arg branch on Linux, and runs export_sys_vars("aws-lc-sys"). export_sys_vars scans std::env::vars() for DEP_AWS_LC_<version>_INCLUDE (populated by Cargo from aws-lc-sys's links = "aws_lc_0_45_0" metadata), locks onto prefix DEP_AWS_LC_0_45_0_, and re-exports all DEP_AWS_LC_0_45_0_<KEY> variables as cargo:<key_lowercase>=<value> while emitting cargo:rerun-if-env-changed=<name> to stderr. It performs no filesystem mutations or external command executions.

aws-lc-sys 0.45.0/builder/main.rs initialization and pregenerated bindings selection: #[cfg(any(feature = "bindgen", feature = "fips"))] mod sys_bindgen is compiled out. initialize() probes 20 AWS_LC_SYS_* configuration variables in target-suffixed (<VAR>_x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu) and bare forms (NO_PREFIX, PREGENERATING_BINDINGS, EXTERNAL_BINDGEN, NO_ASM, PREBUILT_NASM, C_STD, CMAKE_BUILDER, NO_PREGENERATED_SRC, SMALL, EFFECTIVE_TARGET, NO_JITTER_ENTROPY, NO_U1_BINDINGS, INCLUDES, SANITIZER, LINK_WHOLE_ARCHIVE, STATIC, SYSTEM_DIR, USE_SYSTEM, SYSTEM_BINDINGS, SYSTEM_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK), emitting cargo:rerun-if-env-changed for each. Under strict env with none set, prefix is Some("aws_lc_0_45_0") and effective_target() is "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu". Because CARGO_FEATURE_ALL_BINDINGS is unset (default features disabled on aws-lc-sys), is_all_bindings() is false; initialize() takes the !is_fips_crate() universal branch, reads CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS to check for cranelift (emitting cargo:rerun-if-env-changed=CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS), emits cargo:rustc-cfg=universal, and sets PREGENERATED = true. Consequently, has_pregenerated() is true and is_bindgen_required() returns false.

System library detection branch (system_detect.rs / system_library.rs): In get_builder(), get_system_dir_path() is None, and use_system() is None (since AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM is unset). Because use_system() != Some(false) is true by default, system_detect::detect_system_awslc(manifest_dir) always runs unless AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM=0 is set. detect_candidate_layouts() probes OPENSSL_DIR, OPENSSL_INCLUDE_DIR, and OPENSSL_LIB_DIR (in _x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu and bare forms); when unset, on Unix it calls pkg_config_candidates(), which invokes pkg_config::Config::new().cargo_metadata(false).probe(module) for ["openssl", "aws-lc", "libcrypto", "libcrypto-awslc"]. Any candidate returned by pkg-config is tested via SystemLib::probe(): check_dependencies() searches candidate lib_dirs for libcrypto.a/libcrypto-awslc.a (or .so fallback), and validate() requires <include_dir>/openssl/base.h to define OPENSSL_IS_AWSLC with AWSLC_VERSION_NUMBER_STRING >= 1.68.0 and requires pregenerated bindings at <prefix>/share/rust/aws_lc_bindings.rs. Ordinary system OpenSSL or an environment without pkg-config/AWS-LC bindings is non-fatally rejected and falls through to source compilation; if a qualifying system AWS-LC >= 1.68.0 with share/rust/aws_lc_bindings.rs were found via pkg-config, SystemLib would be selected, copying aws_lc_bindings.rs to <OUT_DIR>/bindings.rs and emitting cargo:rustc-cfg=use_bindgen_pregenerated.

Builder selection and inactive branches (cmake_builder, sys_bindgen, fips_probe, nasm_builder): When system_detect returns None, get_builder() checks is_fips_build() (false), is_cmake_builder() (None), is_no_asm() || sanitizer().is_some() (false), and !is_bindgen_required() (true). It constructs CcBuilder with OutputLibType::Static and calls CcBuilder::check_dependencies(), which verifies OutputLibType != Dynamic, CARGO_CFG_TARGET_ENV != "ohos", and CARGO_FEATURE_SSL != Some(true) (emitting cargo:rerun-if-env-changed=CARGO_FEATURE_SSL). This succeeds unconditionally on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, returning CcBuilder ("CC"). Therefore: (1) CmakeBuilder never activates and find_cmake_command() (cmake3/cmake probes), cmake::Config, GOFLAGS/GOCACHE, prebuilt-nasm.sh/.bat, and printenv.bat are never called; (2) internal sys_bindgen is cfg-disabled and external bindgen CLI (verify_bindgen / invoke_external_bindgen) is skipped because bindings_available is set to true when !is_bindgen_required(); (3) fips_probe (compile_fips_probe / run_fips_probe) and link_fips_runtime_check (fips_runtime_check.c) are unreachable because is_fips_build() is false; (4) use_prebuilt_nasm() short-circuits to false on target_os() == "windows" without invoking test_nasm_command(), and NasmBuilder::compile_intermediates() only runs if identify_sources() yields .asm files (returning vec![] immediately before test_nasm_command() when self.files.is_empty()).

Active CcBuilder env, compiler-probe, and filesystem effects (cc_builder.rs & builder/main.rs): CcBuilder::build() emits cargo:root=<OUT_DIR>, selects universal::CRYPTO_LIBRARY and linux_x86_64::CRYPTO_LIBRARY in identify_sources(), and runs build_library(): (1) prepare_builder() reads CFLAGS/CC/CXX env families (AWS_LC_SYS_HOST_*, HOST_*, AWS_LC_SYS_*, bare, and _x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu variants, or TARGET_* if HOST != TARGET), configures cc::Build with -Wno-unused-parameter, -pthread, -D_XOPEN_SOURCE=700, -DBORINGSSL_IMPLEMENTATION=1, -DBORINGSSL_PREFIX=aws_lc_0_45_0, 7 include paths under manifest_dir (including s2n-bignum and jitterentropy), and -Wa,--noexecstack; (2) collect_universal_build_options() and run_compiler_checks() invoke cc::Build::try_compile_intermediates() on <manifest_dir>/aws-lc/tests/compiler_features_tests/{c11.c, stdalign_check.c, builtin_swap_check.c, linux_random_h.c} using temporary directories <OUT_DIR>/out-{c11,stdalign_check,builtin_swap_check,linux_random_h} (created and removed via fs::remove_dir_all), plus for non-debug OPT_LEVEL values probes is_flag_supported for -ffile-prefix-map/-fdebug-prefix-map and (for GNU compilers with CFLAGS temporarily stripped via EnvGuard) -Wa,--debug-prefix-map; (3) memcmp_check() (when HOST == TARGET and compiler is GCC-like) runs <compiler> -dumpfullversion/-dumpversion via Command::new and, only if GCC is 9.0-9.3, 10.0-10.1, or unparseable, compiles and executes <OUT_DIR>/memcmp_invalid_stripped_check from memcmp_invalid_stripped_check.c (reading LDFLAGS) and removes it; (4) add_all_files() compiles third_party/s2n-bignum/* via a cloned cc::Build (with --include=.../boringssl_prefix_symbols_asm.h and -DS2N_BN_HIDE_SYMBOLS=1), compiles third_party/jitterentropy/* via a separate cc::Build at -O0 with PIC and CFLAGS optimization flags temporarily replaced via EnvGuard (with --include=.../boringssl_prefix_symbols.h), and compiles remaining C/.S files and archives <OUT_DIR>/libaws_lc_0_45_0_crypto.a; (5) setup_include_paths() creates <OUT_DIR>/include and copies <manifest_dir>/{include,generated-include,aws-lc/include} into <OUT_DIR>/include via fs::copy/fs_extra::dir::copy with write permissions ensured, and emits cargo:include, cargo:libdir, cargo:link_kind=static, cargo:libcrypto=aws_lc_0_45_0_crypto, cargo:libcrypto_path, cargo:system_libs=, cargo:conf=..., cargo:rerun-if-changed=aws-lc/, and cargo:rerun-if-changed=builder/.
limitations: The 11 architecture/platform source-list submodules declared in public-code/aws-lc-sys-0.45.0/builder/cc_builder.rs (specifically builder/cc_builder/universal.rs and builder/cc_builder/linux_x86_64.rs active on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) are not included in the 75-file packet; they are required to inspect the exact CRYPTO_LIBRARY source file arrays and verify directly from source bytes that no .asm entries are passed to NasmBuilder on Linux x86_64.

The non-builder package contents of aws-lc-sys-0.45.0 (src/lib.rs, pregenerated universal bindings, include/, generated-include/, aws-lc/include/, and aws-lc/tests/compiler_features_tests/*.c) are outside the copied build-root/module packet.

Helper crate implementations (cc 1.7.0, pkg-config 0.3.31, cmake 0.1.54, dunce 1.0.5, fs_extra 1.3.0) and host toolchain/environment state (such as whether pkg-config is present on PATH or whether HOST == TARGET) are assigned to separate helper/execution owners and not inspected or probed here.
The observed Cargo tree is not an exact --test compilation-unit graph and this source-only review does not authorize execution, admission, resource caps, or retries.
